prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
Seamless aged parchment texture — warm cream base with subtle variations,
faint foxing spots, occasional fiber, hint of horizontal grain. A
background surface — no patterns, no illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink-and-watercolor rendering of aged parchment surface, warm vellum cream base with subtle tonal variation and faint foxing, fiber texture visible beneath, soft slate shadow pooling at edges.

subjects.description: Seamless warm cream sheet, faint horizontal grain, scattered foxing spots as soft amber flecks, visible cellulose fiber threads embedded in surface.
Soft vignette of muted slate shadow at corners and margins, faint staining suggesting age and handling, no hard borders.
